Guideline 2.1 - Information Needed

We need more information to continue the review. Please provide:
1. A screen recording captured on a physical device that starts at app launch and shows the main flow.
2. What is the purpose of your app and who is the target audience?
3. Instructions to set up the main features, including any credentials.
4. Which external services, tools or platforms does your app use for its core features?
5. Are there regional differences in how your app works?
